summary.en: One ink shape morphs into another, point for point at equal arc length (480 points), so a card becomes a hexagon without a cut.
summary.zh: 一块墨色形状按等弧长逐点（480 点）变成另一种形状，卡片不经剪切地变成六边形。

fits: A promotion between two closed forms of the same object: card to hexagon, point to circle, pill to card.
notFor: Shapes with holes or several parts (split them first); text.

intent.en: The viewer sees one thing change form, not a cut to another thing, so the new form inherits the old one's meaning.
intent.zh: 观众看到的是一样东西换了形状，而不是切到另一样东西，新形状继承了旧形状的意义。

content.en: Two closed shapes of the same object (card, pill, point, hexagon, circle, or a rect).
content.zh: 同一对象的两个闭合形状（卡片、胶囊、点、六边形、圆，或任意矩形）。

fits.zh: 同一对象两种闭合形态之间的升级：卡片到六边形、点到圆、胶囊到卡片。

notFor.zh: 带洞或多块的形状（先拆开）；文字。

pairs.note: uses it for the card → hexagon

en: Let the old content leave first (0.1 s); morphing an outline with text inside smears the text.
zh: 先让旧内容离开（0.1 秒）；带着文字变形会把字抹花。

overlaps.note: container-morph springs a rect’s width, height and radius; outline-morph blends any two closed outlines point for point (card → hexagon)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
